scripts.start: npm run build && uv run uvicorn backend.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 7171
scripts.setup:ocr: npm run setup:document-ocr && uv run --extra workbook-ocr python -c "from transformers import TrOCRProcessor, VisionEncoderDecoderModel; TrOCRProcessor.from_pretrained('microsoft/trocr-small-handwritten', use_fast=False); VisionEncoderDecoderModel.from_pretrained('microsoft/trocr-small-handwritten')"
scripts.start:workbooks: npm run build && uv run --extra workbook-ocr uvicorn backend.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 7171
